abilities.name: Call of the Ancestors
abilities.desc: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

abilities.name: Call of the Elements
abilities.desc: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

abilities.name: Call of the Spirits
abilities.desc: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.desc: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 119 to 133 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

abilities.name: Earth Shock
abilities.desc: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 293 to 309 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Earthbind Totem
abilities.desc: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Elemental Mastery
abilities.desc: Gain mastery over Fire and Lightning, reducing the cast time of Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from Chain Lightning. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Fire Nova
abilities.desc: Instantly inflicts 232 to 258 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.

abilities.name: Flame Shock
abilities.desc: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 166 Fire damage immediately and 176 Fire damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Shock
abilities.desc: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 278 to 294 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

abilities.name: Lava Burst
abilities.desc: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 192 to 248 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.desc: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 189 to 211 Nature damage.

abilities.name: Magma Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 73 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.desc: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.

abilities.name: Searing Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 to 54 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Stoneclaw Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 486 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.

abilities.name: Totemic Recall
abilities.desc: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

abilities.name: Astral Recall
abilities.desc: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to home. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

abilities.name: Far Sight
abilities.desc: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party or raid members within 30 yards by 60.

abilities.name: Flametongue Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit causes 17 to 55 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Flametongue Weapon
abilities.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 35 to 112 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Frost Resistance Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 60, if within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Frostbrand Weapon
abilities.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 169 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Ghost Wolf
abilities.desc: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

abilities.name: Grace of Air Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Grounding Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.desc: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 178 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Nature Resistance Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.

abilities.name: Rage of the Farseer
abilities.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

abilities.name: Rockbiter Weapon
abilities.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 653 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Sentry Totem
abilities.desc: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and Shaman sight.

abilities.name: Stoneskin Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 30. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Stormstrike
abilities.desc: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Strength of Earth Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Totemic Projection
abilities.desc: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.

abilities.name: Water Breathing
abilities.desc: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

abilities.name: Water Walking
abilities.desc: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Windfury Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 246 extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Windfury Weapon
abilities.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 333 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

abilities.name: Windwall Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 64. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Ancestral Spirit
abilities.desc: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Chain Heal
abilities.desc: Heals the friendly target for 474 to 538, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.

abilities.name: Cure Disease
abilities.desc: Cures 1 disease on the target.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.desc: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

abilities.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Healing Stream Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 11 every 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Healing Wave
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 1,508 to 1,722.

abilities.name: Lesser Healing Wave
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 775 to 865.

abilities.name: Mana Spring Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Mana Tide Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Nature's Swiftness
abilities.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Riptide
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 799 to 883, an additional 805 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

abilities.name: Tremor Totem
abilities.desc: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Water Shield
abilities.desc:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.desc: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.desc: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.desc: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.desc: Increases your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and ends when you enter a raid.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.desc: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.
